reuse.why: Folds the closed-account check into the existing link.ts guard that all six provider link functions already call.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; call sites only change the guard's name.

placement.why: The precondition lives in accounts/link.ts beside the existing one-link-per-bank-account rule, in the shared linking layer.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its tests; the guard rename touches all six call sites, which is justified by the broadened meaning but adds churn.

maintainability.why: One documented precondition function owns every linking rule, so new providers get both checks automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link paths go through the shared guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in accounts/link.ts, called by all six provider link functions in accounts/app.ts.
